6. One-handed sword, ice and thunder fusion skills increase shield breaking and damage

notes.title: It's time to GO ROOOGUE!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/164510abc5369f0210e11eded1e650c6764106ce.png[/img]

Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence is here!

As a member of this fascinating genre, [b]Metal Mutation[/b] also takes part in this event. We made some updates to the Demo a few days ago:

1. Add a beginners' guide
2. Optimize the character's stun locked time when getting hit
3. Reduce difficulty for some monsters
4. Reduce the mutation rate for monsters
5. Optimize the display of some skills

Apart from the above, we'll keep optimizing the sense of attack and striking. Welcome to try our Demo and give us more feedback during this festival!

Thank you all for your support! If you want to get instant access to our development progress and update information, welcome to join our [b]Discord channel: https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR[/b]

LET'S GO ROGUE!ːsteamhappyː
